ui.labSubtitle: Design a badge, save it, apply it to a title, verify it on the real poster.

ui.labOpenSpace: Open your personal space to save and apply
ui.labPublishSaveFirst: Save the preset first, then publish a copy.
ui.labPublishHint: Creates an autonomous public copy; the private original is untouched.
ui.labDefaultHint: Inherited by titles without their own preset. Title presets and off-toggles always win.
ui.labDefaultOk: Preset set as default in your space.

ui.labFreeHint: Design freely: change text, shape, dimensions, background, border and shadow.
ui.labDiscardChanges: Replace the current work? Your unsaved changes will be lost.
ui.labDraftAvailable: You have an unfinished badge on this device.
ui.labDraftStorageError: Draft storage unavailable. Export your work before leaving.
ui.labImportValues: ה-preset מכיל ערכים לא חוקיים או מחוץ לטווח.
